candidates.source_name: E-beszámoló Portál – Beszámoló keresés (Igazságügyi Minisztérium)
candidates.why_relevant: Central statutory filing repository where every Hungarian company (incl. banks, payment institutions, e-money issuers, fintech Kft/Zrt) must publish its annual beszámoló. The kiegészítő melléklet routinely carries átlagos statisztikai állományi létszám (average headcount) and personnel-cost tables, and the üzleti jelentés often names igazgatóság/felügyelőbizottság members. Auditable, dated ground truth for headcount and board composition that press coverage never provides.
candidates.access_status: free public search, per-company PDF download; no documented bulk API
candidates.legal_status: official public register, free access by law
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Maintain an actor list of HU bank/PSP company names + cégjegyzékszám; annually (filings due by 31 May for calendar-year filers) fetch the beszámoló PDF per entity, then parse the kiegészítő melléklet for 'átlagos statisztikai létszám' tables and the governance section for board rosters. Store the PDF hash for change detection.
queries_used: e-beszámoló beszámoló kereső e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu céginformáció

candidates.source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat – beszámoló-állomány értékesítése (bulk filing dataset)
candidates.why_relevant: Official route to obtain the whole filed-accounts corpus (or grouped queries over it) rather than scraping company-by-company. This is the scalable path to sector-wide headcount time series for banks and payment firms.
candidates.access_status: paid/licensed bulk dataset; page itself free
candidates.legal_status: commercial licence from the ministry; terms to be confirmed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Read licensing terms and pricing; if licensed, ingest structured filing dataset instead of PDF scraping. Otherwise treat as documented fallback.
queries_used: e-beszámoló beszámoló kereső e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu céginformáció

candidates.source_name: Cégportál / Ingyenes céginformáció – cégkeresés (IM)
candidates.why_relevant: Official free company register lookup: registered officers (vezető tisztségviselő, képviseletre jogosult), their appointment/termination dates, and registered-seat changes. The registry is the authoritative record of who legally represents a bank or PSP and when they started/stopped — the cleanest signal of silent leadership departures.
candidates.access_status: free basic company data; full cégkivonat may be paid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll per cégjegyzékszám on a monthly cadence for the watchlist of HU credit institutions and payment/e-money institutions; diff the officer list and record appointment/termination dates.
queries_used: e-beszámoló beszámoló kereső e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu céginformáció

candidates.source_name: Cégközlöny Online – kereső (Company Gazette)
candidates.why_relevant: Official gazette publishing court decisions on company data changes — including changes of vezető tisztségviselő, felügyelőbizottsági tag, and registered data — plus direct company announcements. It is the primary, dated publication channel for organizational and leadership changes at Hungarian banks/PSPs before any press release exists.
candidates.access_status: free search and free issue download per the Céginformációs Szolgálat description
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly harvest of issues; filter by watchlist cégjegyzékszám/company name; extract change items (bejegyzés/változásbejegyzés/törlés) affecting officers and supervisory board.
queries_used: Cégközlöny közzétételi és értesítési lap cegkozlony.hu online kereső

candidates.source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat – Cégfigyelés (official company-monitoring service)
candidates.why_relevant: Official subscription alerting on Cégközlöny entries and submissions for monitored companies — turns the gazette from a polling problem into a push feed for a fixed watchlist of banks and payment institutions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Register the watchlist; route notifications into the collection pipeline as event triggers.
queries_used: Cégközlöny közzétételi és értesítési lap cegkozlony.hu online kereső

candidates.source_name: OTP Bank Nyrt. – Éves jelentés / Integrált éves jelentés (IR)
candidates.why_relevant: Largest HU bank's integrated annual report: igazgatóság and felügyelőbizottság rosters with professional bios, group headcount ('záró létszám'/average headcount) by country and segment, and organizational structure. Year-over-year diffs of these tables reveal both leadership churn and restructuring.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull (April/May); parse governance chapter for board rosters and the HR/notes chapter for headcount; keep a normalized person-role-date table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query, verified via search result listing IR pages

candidates.why_relevant: AGM proposals and resolutions state elections, re-elections and terminations of igazgatóság/felügyelőbizottság/audit bizottság members with exact effective dates — the crispest primary record of board-level leadership moves, published before annual reports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the IR pénzügyi naptár for AGM dates; pull közgyűlési előterjesztések + határozatok each spring for every listed HU bank.
candidates.discovered_via_method: search result snowball from OTP IR query

candidates.why_relevant: Hungary's second-largest bank, formed by the Budapest Bank / MKB / Takarékbank merger — its annual reports and AGM packs are the auditable record of post-merger headcount reduction and board reconstitution, exactly the organizational-change signal this cell must anchor.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull; parse 'átlagos statisztikai állományi létszám' and board sections; compare against legacy MKB/Budapest Bank/Takarékbank filings on e-beszámoló for merger-driven headcount deltas.

candidates.source_name: MNB Közzétételek (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) – regulated-information repository
candidates.why_relevant: The regulator-operated storage mechanism where HU issuers (incl. OTP, MBH, Gránit and bank bond issuers) must file regulated information: annual and interim reports, corporate governance reports, and extraordinary disclosures on management changes. A single-domain archive covering all listed banks, independent of any bank's own website reorganisations.
candidates.access_status: free public web application with document download endpoints
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query by issuer, harvest document metadata (id/did) and PDFs; classify into rendkívüli tájékoztatás (extraordinary disclosure) vs annual report; alert on disclosures mentioning vezérigazgató/igazgatóság/felügyelőbizottság.

candidates.why_relevant: Parallel mandatory publication venue for HU listed banks; its newkibdata file store hosts the actual annual-report and AGM PDFs (e.g. OTP integrated annual report, MBH quarterly reports, Gránit company page), making it a stable secondary retrieval path when issuer sites move files.

candidates.source_name: MNB – Személyi engedélyek / vezető állású személy authorisation pages
candidates.why_relevant: Senior appointments at Hungarian banks, payment institutions and e-money issuers require prior MNB personal authorisation (vezető állású személy). The authorisation subject pages document the process and point to the decision register — MNB approval decisions are a leading indicator of a leadership move, often preceding any public announcement.
candidates.access_status: guidance pages free; the searchable decision register (határozatok) needs a separate locate step
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the MNB határozatok/engedélyek search and filter by intézmény + 'vezető állású személy'; poll monthly. Use the guidance PDFs to learn the exact decision wording to match on.

candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine – CDX Server API (leadership-page diffing)
candidates.why_relevant: The core ARCHIVE/AUDIT instrument for this cell: the CDX index returns every capture of a bank's 'vezetőség'/'management'/'rólunk' page with timestamp, status and content digest. Digest changes pinpoint when a name silently disappeared from a leadership page — detecting departures that were never announced.
candidates.legal_status: public archive; respect rate limits and IA terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: For each bank/PSP leadership URL run a CDX query (url=..., output=json, collapse=digest) to get only changed captures; fetch the changed snapshots, extract person names/titles, and emit a person-appeared / person-disappeared event timeline. Also run host-prefix queries to discover leadership URLs that no longer exist on the live site.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query (archive diffing) + API documentation search

negative_findings.description: No documented free bulk-download or public API for e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu filings was found; the free route appears to be per-company interactive search, with bulk access routed through a paid 'beszámoló állomány értékesítése' licence.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the search page and the ministry's data-sale page were located; no open API endpoint or dataset dump surfaced in hu-language searching.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sector-wide headcount time series for HU banks and payment institutions will require either paid licensing or per-entity PDF harvesting, which changes the cost and cadence of this workstream.

negative_findings.description: A directly searchable, machine-readable MNB register of granted 'vezető állású személy' személyi engedély decisions per institution was not located in this pass; only the process/guidance pages and PDF engedélyezési útmutatók were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: MNB pages describe the requirement for prior authorisation of senior appointments at payment institutions and financial enterprises, but the searchable decision list was not reached.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MNB approvals are the earliest verifiable signal of a leadership move; without locating the decision register this cell loses its leading indicator and falls back to post-hoc filings.

negative_findings.description: It was not confirmed whether the MNB Aranykönyv per-institution dataset includes an employee-count (létszám) field, or only balance-sheet and income-statement categories.
negative_findings.result_summary: Descriptions of the Aranykönyv mention selected balance-sheet/P&L categories, fund assets and membership data; staff counts were not explicitly mentioned.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If Aranykönyv lacks létszám, the only comparable per-institution headcount series remains the filed beszámoló kiegészítő melléklet, making the e-beszámoló route non-optional.

negative_findings.description: No Hungarian-language search result in this pass surfaced an existing published Wayback-diff study or tooling specifically applied to Hungarian bank 'vezetőség' pages; the archive-diff capability must be built in-house.
negative_findings.result_summary: Wayback CDX documentation and generic change-detection tooling were found, but no HU-banking-specific archival monitoring source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's archive/audit role is genuinely unserved by any existing source and must be implemented as a custom collector.

negative_findings.description: All URLs in this slice come from search-result listings; none were individually fetched and confirmed reachable in this pass. One observed result ('e-beszamolo.im.gov.hu/oldal/kereses_merleglista') was labelled a 404 page in results, suggesting some legacy e-beszámoló paths have moved rather than died.
negative_findings.result_summary: Liveness is unverified by design; the merged pipeline's deterministic verification pass must confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents downstream consumers from treating these as verified-live endpoints and flags that e-beszámoló deep links are unstable and should be re-derived from the search page rather than hard-coded.

coverage_gaps.description: Only OTP, MBH, Gránit and UniCredit were reached at issuer-report level. K&H, Erste, Raiffeisen, CIB, Erste/other jelzálogbank issuers, Magyar Bankholding legacy entities, MFB, Eximbank and the savings-cooperative successors have no per-bank annual-report source entry yet.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the full watchlist from the MNB Aranykönyv institution list and the Magyar Bankszövetség member list, then locate each bank's 'éves jelentés' page and its e-beszámoló filing record.

coverage_gaps.description: Payments-side actors (pénzforgalmi intézmények, e-money issuers, acquirers and fintechs such as OTP Mobil/Simple, Barion, Global Payments Hungary, Revolut's HU entity, Wise HU) were not individually sourced; the payment sector was covered only through the generic registers.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the MNB list of licensed pénzforgalmi intézmény / elektronikuspénz-kibocsátó intézmény entities, resolve each to a cégjegyzékszám, and register their e-beszámoló filings and cégjegyzék officer records as sources.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language equivalents of the archival layer (IFRS 'Annual Report' English editions, EBA/ECB-level registers, GLEIF LEI records of HU bank entities with legal-name and status change history) were not sourced.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add English annual-report URLs for each bank and evaluate GLEIF/EBA credit-institution registers as cross-border corroboration for entity and status changes.

coverage_gaps.description: No source was established for branch-network and site-level organisational footprint (fiókhálózat closures), which is the physical correlate of headcount reduction and a strong organization-change signal.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check whether Aranykönyv or MNB supervisory publications carry fióktelep counts per institution, and add Wayback diffing of bank 'fiókkereső / bankfiók' pages as an archival proxy.

coverage_gaps.description: Two of the highest-value routes (bulk filing dataset, OPTEN officer-change history) are commercial and their terms were not read; scraping either would likely breach ToS.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain and record licence terms and pricing before pipeline design; document a free fallback (per-entity e-beszámoló + Cégközlöny harvesting) in case licensing is declined.

brief: Hungary's corporate-filing layer for banking and payments is unusually strong and almost entirely state-operated: e-beszámoló holds every entity's statutory accounts (with the átlagos statisztikai állományi létszám note that is the only per-institution headcount ground truth), while cegportal.im.gov.hu and Cégközlöny record officer appointments and terminations with legal effect dates. For listed banks a triple-publication rule means every annual report, corporate-governance report and extraordinary leadership disclosure exists in three archivable places at once — the issuer site, bet.hu, and kozzetetelek.mnb.hu — and MNB's Aranykönyv plus the personal-authorisation regime supply the institution universe and a potential leading indicator of senior appointments. The genuinely unserved capability is archival diffing: nothing published tracks Hungarian bank 'vezetőség' pages over time, so the Wayback CDX index must be driven in-house with digest-collapsed queries to catch silent, unannounced departures. Main gaps are actor breadth beyond the four banks reached here, the whole payment-institution and fintech tier, and the unread commercial terms on the two bulk data routes.
